title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, make a narrowed gap actually carry new information instead
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, make a narrowed gap actually carry new information instead of restating its parent.

ANCHOR. This exact line occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the file:
          summary: `[narrowed from ${parentId}] ${parentSummary.replace(/^\[narrowed from [\w:.!-]+\]\s*/g, "")}`,

ONE OPERATION. Replace that single line with exactly:
          summary: `[narrowed from ${parentId}] ${parentSummary.replace(/^\[narrowed from [\w:.!-]+\]\s*/g, "")}${(() => { const ls = Array.isArray((meta as Record<string, unknown>)["failure_lessons"]) ? ((meta as Record<string, unknown>)["failure_lessons"] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) : []; if (ls.length === 0) return ""; const recent = ls.slice(-3).map((l) => `- ${String(l["class"] ?? "?")}: ${String(l["reason"] ?? "").slice(0, 300)}`).join("\n"); return `\n\nWHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (carried forward from ${parentId}, most recent last):\n${recent}\n\nDo not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.`; })()}`,

Change nothing else. Do not touch childMeta, the childRecord id, the surrounding branch, the comment above it, the top of the file, or any import.

WHY. This is the chronic-failure narrowing branch: it fires when a gap has failed repeatedly and is meant to produce a more tractable child. The comment directly above it states "The child carries a tighter description". The code does not implement one - the child summary is the parent's text with a prefix prepended, so the narrowed gap tells the drafter exactly what the parent told it, having already failed with that description at least three times. The only other thing the branch does is set failed_attempts to 0, which the code itself explains is so the gap "re-enters the dispatch queue at normal priority rather than being culled by the landabilityScore filter".

MEASURED CONSEQUENCE. Paired within-gap comparison over 259 parent/narrowed pairs: landing rate 7.3% (19/259) for parents versus 7.7% (20/259) for their narrowed children, and the share of summaries carrying a concrete proposed change rises only from 5% to 8%. 259 narrowing operations for a 0.4 percentage-point difference. Because the description is carried across unchanged, no improvement is expected and none is observed.

WHY THIS FIX. The failure lessons are already attached to the gap in classification_metadata.failure_lessons - the class and reason for each prior attempt. That is precisely the information a fresh attempt needs and currently does not receive, and it is available at this point with no extra read. Carrying the three most recent lessons into the child summary makes the narrowed gap genuinely more informative than its parent, which is what the existing comment already promises. This is deterministic: it needs no model call and cannot fail.

The `meta` variable is in scope here - it is spread into childMeta on the line a few above. The fallback is deliberate: when there are no lessons the appended string is empty and the summary is byte-identical to today's, so nothing can regress.

FALSIFIER. After this lands, read any newly created -narrowed gap and confirm its summary contains a "WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED" section naming concrete failure classes, rather than only the parent's prose.
